[[File:Trinket of undead detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''trinket of undead''' is an item in [[Deadman Mode]] that allows players to summon a special [[thrall]] of the player's choice, being either [[TzRek-Zuk]], the [[Kalphite Princess#Flying|Kalphite Princess]], or [[Wisp]]. These thralls function the same as greater thralls, functioning as a melee, ranged, or magic thrall respectively. Though the trinket has no requirements to use, it does have a 10 second cooldown.

Being identical to regular greater thralls, the trinket's thralls always deal [[successful hit]]s, with the damage roll ranging from 0-3. The damage roll can be increased to 0-15 with the [[sigil of the augmented thrall]].

It can be acquired as a drop from monsters found during [[breach]]es, as well as from looting the [[Deadman's chest (scenery)|Deadman's chest]].

==Special attack==
[[File:Immolate.gif|thumb|250px|A player performing the regular volatile Nightmare staff's special attack, ''Immolate''.]]
The corrupted volatile Nightmare staff has a [[special attack]], ''Immolate'', that consumes 55% of the player's special attack energy to hit the target with 50% increased accuracy and deals a high amount of damage. The special attack does not consume runes.

When calculating the max hit, Immolate acts like any other spell. The spell's max hit is calculated first and then rounded down. All [[magic damage]] gear, including the +15% from the staff is calculated separately. Because the staff has a magic damage bonus, the max hit seen in-game will always be higher than the spell's max hit. The max hit varies with visible Magic level according to the formula below.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1765337358294003882|date=06 March 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108809|archivedate=03 May 2026|quote=[What is the formula for the Volatile staff's special attack base maxhit?] The base is 58, scaled up or down by your *visible* Magic stat divided by 99, if I'm reading my colleagues' code correctly.}} The spell's max hit is limited to, at most, 58. This means that even though the max hit is based on the player's magic level, [[Temporary skill boost|boosting]] above magic level 98 will not increase the max hit. It can be increased though by using additional magic damage gear including the [[Slayer helmet (i)]] when on a [[slayer task]].

For additional details, [[Volatile Nightmare staff#Special attack|see volatile Nightmare staff]]

The '''thunder khopesh''' was an unlock in the [[Grid Master]] [[community event]]. After the player builds a [[demonic throne]] in their [[player-owned house]], the player is given the thunder khopesh.

[[File:Thunder khopesh - passive effect.webp|thumb|left|275x275px|The thunder khopesh's passive effect.]]
It has a [[passive effect]] that grants standard, [[successful hit]]s a 20% chance to summon a delayed lightning bolt at the target's location, damaging enemies in a 3x3 area for up to 50% of the player's max hit. The lightning bolt will be summoned at the centre of the target's location at the time the effect was triggered.

The lightning does not roll accuracy checks, but it is possible for enemies to move out of the effect between the attack triggering and the attack striking, causing them to avoid the damage entirely. No experience is gained from the damage dealt by the lightning bolts.

It is a [[corpbane]] weapon, meaning it does full damage to the [[Corporeal Beast]].

==Special attack==
[[File:Lingering Lightning.webm|A player performing the thunder khopesh's special attack.|thumb|autoplay|loop|200px]]
The thunder khopesh has a [[special attack]], ''Lingering Lightning'', which consumes 50% of the wielder's special attack energy. The special attack deals two hits in quick succession; if either of these is a [[successful hit]], an additional lightning bolt is summoned that deals damage up to 100% of the player's maximum hit. Aside from a guaranteed chance to trigger and a much higher max hit, the mechanics of the lightning bolt from the special attack are otherwise identical to the lightning bolt from the passive effect.

==Past appearances==
This item appeared in a previous [[temporary event]], with the following differences from its latest incarnation:
*[[Raging Echoes League]]
**The khopesh was dropped by the [[Echo King Black Dragon]] at a rate of 1/25.
**The special attack had the same official description, but dealt much higher damage than described: the initial two hitsplats had a 50% increased maximum hit, and the subsequent lightning bolt dealt up to 225% of the player's maximum hit.

The '''trinket of fortuity''' is an item in [[Deadman Mode]]. When charged with 50,000,000 [[coins]], it adds an extra +100% drop rate multiplier to bosses. For example, this would boost a drop rate multiplier of 6x to 7x. It also makes teleportation behave as if the player is skulled when charged, which adds a seven second timer when attempting to teleport.

In [[Deadman: Annihilation]], it only requires 10,000,000 coins to charge instead of 50,000,000. 

It can be acquired as a drop from monsters found during [[breach]]es.

[[File:Amulet of fire detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''amulet of fire''' is an amulet requiring level 59 [[Magic]] to equip. It is made by using a [[fire ruby]] on the [[Fire Altar]], along with an [[amulet of magic]] and 100 [[fire rune]]s; creating the amulet requires level 21 [[Runecraft]], granting 125 experience. It can also be created when accessing the altars via [[Guardians of the Rift]], as they are the same altars as outside the minigame.

Alongside identical stats to an amulet of magic, the amulet of fire adds a +2 max hit to [[fire spells]], which is added before [[magic damage]] and [[elemental weakness]] modifiers are applied, and therefore scales with both. Additionally, this +2 max hit stacks additively with the bonus from the [[chaos gauntlets]], for a total of +5 max hits when casting [[bolt spells]]. Lastly, the max hit bonus also works against [[Salarin the twisted]].

The amulet of fire, alongside the [[Amulet of air|amulets of air]], [[Amulet of water|water]], and [[Amulet of earth|earth]], can be combined into an [[elemental amulet]] at any elemental [[runic altar]], which combines the effects of all four amulets into one. Doing so requires level 30 [[Runecraft]] and 500 of each elemental rune, granting 175 experience.
